examples.en: The children are expert at holding their breath under water.

grammar.title: 被动语态（Passive Voice）
grammar.structure: 主语 + be动词 + 过去分词 + (by + 执行者)
grammar.definition: 当句子的主语是动作的承受者时，使用被动语态。主动语态强调动作执行者，被动语态强调动作本身或承受者。 当不必指出动作执行者、或动作执行者不明确时使用。也用于强调动作的承受者。

examples.en: Children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
examples.zh: 孩子们在很小的年龄就可以接受游泳训练。

examples.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool.
Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions remains to be seen.
examples.zh: 他们是否会成为未来的奥运冠军还有待观察。

grammar.title: so...that 引导的结果状语从句
grammar.structure: so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果状语从句
grammar.definition: so是副词，修饰形容词或副词，that引导结果状语从句，表示"如此...以至于..." 用于描述程度，强调某种情况导致的结果。

examples.en: They are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights.
examples.zh: 他们如此习惯游泳以至于能捡起池底的重量。

examples.en: It is so hot that we cannot go outside.
examples.zh: 天气太热了，我们不能出去。

examples.en: She is so tall that she can reach the top shelf.
examples.zh: 她很高以至于能够到最高的架子。

grammar.title: whether 引导的主语从句
grammar.structure: Whether + 主语 + 谓语 + 其他成分
grammar.definition: whether引导的主语从句位于句首，表示"是否"，表达不确定性或未知的事情 用于表达某事是不确定的，需要时间来证明。

examples.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
examples.zh: 他们是否会成为未来的奥运冠军，只有时间才能证明。

examples.en: Whether he will come is not sure.
Whether she passes the exam depends on her efforts.
examples.zh: 她是否能通过考试取决于她的努力。

original.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.

patterns.pattern: A game that is very popular with...

original.en: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
original.zh: 这些年轻游泳者非常受欢迎的一项游戏是水下三轮车比赛。

imitations.zh: 年轻人大受欢迎的一项运动是滑板。

lines.en: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
lines.zh: 实验证明，儿童在很小的时候就可以开始学习游泳。

lines.en: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles, children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
lines.zh: 在洛杉矶的一个特设的游泳池里，孩子们甚至在还没有学会走路时就已经能熟练地在水下屏住呼吸了。

lines.en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
lines.zh: 两个月的婴儿并未显得不愿意入水。

lines.en: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
lines.zh: 他们很快便适应了游泳，以致能捡起池底的物品。

lines.en: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
lines.zh: 这些幼小的游泳运动员非常喜爱的一种游戏是水下三轮车比赛。

lines.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
lines.zh: 三轮车并排放在7英尺深的游泳池底上。

lines.en: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
lines.zh: 孩子们比赛看谁先到达游泳池的另一端。

lines.en: Many pedal their tricycles, but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
lines.zh: 很多孩子用脚蹬车，但多数孩子更愿意推或是拉着三轮车。

lines.en: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
lines.zh: 有些孩子能够跑完游泳池的全长而不用露出水面换气。

lines.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
lines.zh: 他们将来是否能成为奥林匹克的冠军，这只能由时间来作出回答。

lines.en: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
lines.zh: 与此同时，他们对我们中的那些游不了5码就已喘不过气来的人应该是种鼓舞。

questions.q: What kind of race do the children compete in?
questions.zh: 孩子们参加的是哪一种比赛？

questions.aZh: 他们参加的是水下三轮车比赛。
questions.hint: 答案见课文第5、7句：A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race... The children compete against each other...

questions.q: What are the children able to do under water even before they can walk?
questions.zh: 孩子们甚至在学会走路之前就能在水下做什么？
questions.a: They become expert at holding their breath under water.
questions.aZh: 他们能熟练地在水下屏住呼吸。
questions.hint: 课文第2句：children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.

questions.q: Where are the tricycles lined up, and what do the children do with them?
questions.zh: 三轮车摆在哪里？孩子们拿它们做什么？
questions.a: The tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water, and the children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
questions.aZh: 三轮车并排放在水下七英尺深的池底，孩子们比赛看谁先到达游泳池的另一端。
questions.hint: 课文第6、7句：lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water... compete against each other to reach the other end.

questions.q: What does the writer say about the children's chances of becoming Olympic champions?
questions.zh: 作者怎样看待这些孩子成为奥运冠军的前景？
questions.a: Only time will tell whether they will ever become future Olympic champions.
questions.aZh: 他们将来是否能成为奥林匹克的冠军，这只能由时间来作出回答。
questions.hint: 课文第10句：Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.

questions.q: The writer says these children should encourage those of us who cannot swim five yards before gasping for air. What does he really mean?
questions.zh: 作者说这些孩子对“游不了5码就喘不过气来的人”是种鼓舞，他真正的意思是什么？
questions.a: He means that if even two-month-old babies can feel at home under water, no adult need despair of learning to swim; their skill is an encouragement rather than a reproach.
questions.aZh: 他的意思是：连两个月的婴儿都能在水下自如活动，成年人就更不必对学游泳灰心；这些孩子的本领对我们是一种鼓舞，而不是嘲讽。
questions.hint: 结合课文最后一句中 encourage 与 cannot swim five yards before gasping for air 的对比来思考。

translation:
实验证明，儿童在很小的时候就可以开始学习游泳。
在洛杉矶的一个特设的游泳池里，孩子们甚至在还没有学会走路时就已经能熟练地在水下屏住呼吸了。
两个月的婴儿并未显得不愿意入水。
他们很快便适应了游泳，以致能捡起池底的物品。
这些幼小的游泳运动员非常喜爱的一种游戏是水下三轮车比赛。
三轮车并排放在7英尺深的游泳池底上。
孩子们比赛看谁先到达游泳池的另一端。
很多孩子用脚蹬车，但多数孩子更愿意推或是拉着三轮车。
有些孩子能够跑完游泳池的全长而不用露出水面换气。
他们将来是否能成为奥林匹克的冠军，这只能由时间来作出回答。
与此同时，他们对我们中的那些游不了5码就已喘不过气来的人应该是种鼓舞。
title: Future Champions
subtitle: 未来的冠军

lead.question: 洛杉矶的婴儿为何能在水下骑车比赛，他们真能成为未来的奥运冠军吗？
lead.warmup: 洛杉矶有一家特设的游泳池，两个月大的婴儿在此学游泳，还没学会走路就练会在水下屏住呼吸。他们最爱的游戏是水下三轮车比赛：三轮车并排摆在水下七英尺的池底，谁先到对岸谁就赢。本课围绕这群小游泳者展开，你会读到 instruct、compete、reluctant 等词汇，以及 so...that、be accustomed to doing 等常用结构。
goals: 掌握 instruct、champion、compete、reluctant、accustomed、popular、pedal 等本课核心词汇及其搭配
学会 be expert at / be accustomed to / be reluctant to 后接名词或动名词的用法
掌握 so...that 引导的结果状语从句，以及 not long before 表示“不久”的句型
会用 compete against/with、be popular with、line up 等固定搭配，并理解只有时间能回答这类倒装句
lead.summary: 实验证明，儿童很小就能被教会游泳。在洛杉矶特设的游泳池里，两个月大的婴儿不怕入水，还没会走路就能在水下屏住呼吸，很快便能捡起池底物品。他们最爱水下三轮车比赛：三轮车并排放在七英尺深的池底，孩子们争相比谁先游到对岸，多数人宁愿推或拉。能否成为奥运冠军，只有时间能回答。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：be accustomed to、be reluctant to、be expert at 中的 to/at 都是介词，后面须接名词或动名词；使役动词 make/have 后接 sb do sth，动词前不带 to。

exercises.q: 汉译英：实验证明，儿童在很小的时候就可以开始学习游泳。
exercises.a: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
exercises.note: instruct sb in sth，此处用被动

exercises.q: 填空：Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant ___ (enter) the water.
句型转换：They are accustomed to swimming. They can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.（用 so...that 合并）
exercises.a: They are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
exercises.note: so...that 引导结果状语从句

exercises.q: 句型转换：The instructor makes the children dive into the water.（改用 have sb do sth 结构）
exercises.a: The instructor has the children dive into the water.
exercises.note: have sb do sth 为使役用法

exercises.q: 改错：Many of them prefer push their tricycles, but most of them prefer to pedal them.
exercises.a: prefer push → prefer to push（或 prefer pushing）
exercises.note: prefer 后接 to do 或 doing

exercises.q: 汉译英：他只是一名业余游泳者，却梦想成为冠军。
exercises.a: He is only an amateur swimmer, but he dreams of becoming a champion.

exercises.q: 填空：The children compete ___ each other to reach the other end of the pool, and swimming is very popular ___ these young swimmers.
